collection.title: Ford Kuga 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Kuga 2019 Onwards version uses a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" wiper blade on the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Kuga which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
